shortDescription: Adds a new URL Filtering rule.

options.name: action
options.description: Action taken when traffic matches rule criteria When the action is set to CAUTION the attribute request_methods accepts only the following values are CONNECT GET HEAD

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: block_override
options.description: When set to true, a BLOCK action triggered by the rule could be overridden. If true and both override_group and override_users are not set, the BLOCK triggered by this rule could be overridden for any users. If block_override is not set, BLOCK action cannot be overridden.

options.name: cbi_profile
options.description: The cloud browser isolation profile to which the ISOLATE action is applied in the URL Filtering Policy rules. This parameter is required for the ISOLATE action and is not applicable to other actions.

options.name: cipa_rule
options.description: If set to true, the CIPA Compliance rule is enabled

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: departments
options.description: Name-ID pairs of departments for which rule will be applied

options.name: description
options.description: Additional information about the rule

options.name: device_groups
options.description: Name-ID pairs of device groups for which the rule must be applied. This field is applicable for devices that are managed using Zscaler Client Connector. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

options.name: device_trust_levels
options.description: List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. This field is applicable for devices that are managed using Zscaler Client Connector. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your posture configurations. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

options.name: devices
options.description: Name-ID pairs of devices for which rule must be applied. Specifies devices that are managed using Zscaler Client Connector. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Determines whether the URL Filtering rule is enabled or disabled

options.name: end_user_notification_url
options.description: URL of end user notification page to be displayed when the rule is matched. Not applicable if either override_users or override_groups is specified.

options.name: enforce_time_validity
options.description: Enforce a set a validity time period for the URL Filtering rule.

options.name: groups
options.description: Name-ID pairs of groups for which rule must be applied

options.name: id
options.description: Unique identifier for the URL Filtering policy rule

options.name: labels
options.description: The URL Filtering rule label. Rule labels allow you to logically group your organization policy rules. Policy rules that are not associated with a rule label are grouped under the Untagged label.

options.name: location_groups
options.description: Name-ID pairs of the location groups to which the rule must be applied.

options.name: locations
options.description: Name-ID pairs of locations for which rule must be applied

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the URL Filtering policy rule

options.name: order
options.description: Rule order number of the URL Filtering policy rule

options.name: override_groups
options.description: Name-ID pairs of groups for which this rule can be overridden. Applicable only if block_override is set to true and action is BLOCK. If this override_groups is not set, BLOCK action can be overridden for any group.

options.name: override_users
options.description: Name-ID pairs of users for which this rule can be overridden. Applicable only if block_override is set to true, action is BLOCK and override_groups is not set. If this override_users is not set, BLOCK action can be overridden for any user.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: protocols
options.description: Protocol criteria

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: rank
options.description: Admin rank of the admin who creates this rule

options.name: request_methods
options.description: Request method for which the rule must be applied. If not set, rule will be applied to all methods"

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: size_quota
options.description: Action must be set to CAUTION Size quota in MB beyond which the URL Filtering rule is applied. The allowed range is between 10 MB and 100000 MB If not set, no quota is enforced. If a policy rule action is set to BLOCK, this field is not applicable.

options.name: source_ip_groups
options.description: User-defined source IP address groups for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IP address group.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: time_quota
options.description: Action must be set to CAUTION Time quota in minutes, after which the URL Filtering rule is applied. The allowed range is between 15 minutes and 600 minutes. If not set, no quota is enforced. If a policy rule action is set to BLOCK, this field is not applicable.

options.name: time_windows
options.description: Name-ID pairs of time interval during which rule must be enforced.

options.name: url_categories
options.description: The URL categories to which the rule applies Use the info resource zia_url_categories_info to retrieve the category names.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: user_agent_types
options.description: Any number of user agents to which the rule applies.

options.name: user_risk_score_levels
options.description: Indicates the user risk level selected for the DLP rule violation.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: users
options.description: Name-ID pairs of users for which rule must be applied

options.name: validity_end_time
options.description: If enforce_time_validity is set to true, the URL Filtering rule will cease to be valid on this end date and time. Example ( 12/21/2023 12:00 AM )

options.name: validity_start_time
options.description: If enforce_time_validity is set to true, the URL Filtering rule will be valid starting on this date and time. Example ( 11/20/2023 11:59 PM ) Notice that validity_start_time cannot be in the past

options.name: validity_time_zone_id
options.description: If enforceTimeValidity is set to true, the URL Filtering rule date and time is valid based on this time zone ID.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: workload_groups
options.description: The list of preconfigured workload groups to which the policy must be applied.
